title: Instagram Multiple User Accounts Support iPhone App Walkthrough
description: The day has finally arrived, Instagram now allows the support of multiple user accounts on both iOS and Android! Check out our video on how to get it all setup.  State of Tech - http://stateoftech.net  Find us here: Facebook - http://www.fb.com/stateoftech Twitter - http://www.twitter.com/stateoftech Instagram - http://instagram.com/stateoftech

asr.full_text: Hey it's Jared and I wanted to show you guys how to enable multi-account support in Instagram. So this is a thing that I have been wanting forever... and the issue being is that we haven't had multi-account support for a long time. For me that's required having multiple phones or devices or having an Android device that supports multiple users so that I can switch between. It's just really kind of a pain. It's available now for iOS and Android. So if you have the latest up to date version of Instagram you're going to see these features. If you have two accounts added you'll have have your dropdown right here, which is really awesome. Then down below in the bottom right-hand corner, you'll notice my icon for that account that I'm currently selected on so that I know which account I'm currently using. To enable an additional account, tap on the gear at the top, right hand corner, scroll all the way down to the bottom and then click on add account. Now add account is gonna take you to the screen, basically the beginning screen of Instagram and we can go ahead and add in an account. So I'm gonna put State of Tech in here. And I'll go ahead and put in the password. And when we're logged in, it's going to automatically add us here. You'll see your account. It updates with the icon down in the bottom-right-hand corner. We can now switch between all of our accounts that we're signed into here, and you can see, I have three accounts that I'm signed into, which is fantastic. Let's just go ahead and add a fourth, just for the heck of it. All right, so now we have a fourth account added in. This is amazing. This is something that I've wanted for so long. We have multi account support with Twitter. We have an app for all of our different Facebook pages. And now we have the ability to manage multiple Instagram accounts from within one application. If you have any questions about this, go ahead and ask in the comment section below, we'll do our best to answer them. Instagram is rolling this out, so not everybody may have this feature yet, but it was announced that they are rolling this out, so not everybody may have this feature yet, but it was announced that they are rolling this out, so within the next few days after this video having posted, you should be able to get that update and be able to add multiple accounts. So we are stateoftech and we post videos and talk about stuff like this quite often, so follow us on Instagram, we're starting to try and post more often on Instagram. We'd love to have you along for the ride. Make sure to subscribe to our channel here on YouTube and like this video if you found it useful. Thanks so much and we'll see you next time.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides a practical walkthrough for enabling and switching between multiple Instagram accounts. The Instagram options menu, account-switching list, and Add Account control are consistent with the stated app tutorial, and entering a password is described as part of account setup rather than a separate solicitation, payment request, or deceptive destination.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary technology and operational demonstration: the speaker explains how to enable Instagram multi-account support, add an account, and switch between signed-in accounts.
